---
title: "Economic Series Explorer"
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { toRows } from "./js/series.js"

registry = (await fetch("data/series.json")).json()
meta = registry[0]
series = (await fetch(`data/${meta.id}.json`)).json()
rows = toRows(series)

Plot.plot({
  title: series.name,
  width,
  y: { label: series.unit, grid: true },
  x: { label: null },
  marks: [Plot.lineY(rows, { x: "date", y: "value" })]
})
```
